items.label: E1
items.text: Ladders are not permitted in the orchard overnight and must be returned to the tool shed.

items.label: E2
items.text:
Before leaving the shed, each worker must:
1. Clean the blades.
2. Hang every tool on its hook.
3. Sign the tool register.

items.label: E3
items.text: A picker may fill at most 40 crates per shift. Damaged fruit is placed in the compost bin, not in the crates. The harvest supervisor checks the crate count at the end of every shift. Crates are stacked no more than five high. Stacks taller than five crates must be split before the cart leaves the row. The cart driver confirms the stack height before moving. Fruit picked after sunset is recorded separately. Late fruit is stored in the cool room until the next morning.

items.label: E4
items.text: Ladders are permitted in the orchard only when a second worker holds the base of the ladder.

items.label: E5
items.text: During a storm the keeper stays in the lantern room. The fog signal sounds every 30 seconds while visibility is below 2 kilometres.

items.label: E6
items.text: The lamp of the fixture lighthouse must be cleaned every evening before sunset. Keepers record each cleaning in the lamp register.
